turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
I don't think this is productive.
"Productive." You asked for this meeting, Hale, and you haven't answered my question. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
Then I'll be in the principal's office before your class starts. The zero comes off, and I'll want it in writing why nobody called me first. Your choice, Hale.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

Not email, Hale, I'm walking down there now. Your own procedure, 4.2, says I get a call before any mark is entered, and I didn't get one. I'm writing down that you ended this meeting without answering a single question.
